description: Strictly read-only Zapier inspection: verify the connected account, list and search Zaps, inspect historical runs, and diagnose failed steps.

env_var_specs.name: ZAPIER_SESSION_COOKIE
env_var_specs.description: Expert-only environment override. Normal setup uses zapier-pp-cli auth browser and protected local credential storage; users never copy or paste this value.

tools.name: session_check
tools.description: Read the current Zapier session to verify which account is connected; makes no remote change.
